item.title: LIMP BIZKIT's Top 5 Songs Ranked By Fans, From Deep Cuts To Major Hits
item.description: Limp Bizkit helped define the sound and attitude of late ’90s nu-metal. Known for mixing heavy guitars, rap vocals, and over-the-top energy, the band became one of the most talked-about acts of their time.
